verdict.rationale: Isaac ROS offers ready-to-use, plug-and-play packages for common behaviors such as navigation, perception, object detection, manipulation and trajectory optimization. Isaac Lab ships batteries-included robot assets for common hardware, and Isaac Sim's modules can be pulled as Python namespace packages via pip. missing for 10: an explicitly documented registry or index for discovering and installing Isaac ROS packages, reusable hardware driver or sensor modules beyond simulated robot assets, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the package workflow.
